CustomField.description: Visual representation of the stored severity classification.
CustomField.formula: CASE(TEXT(Severity__c), "CRITICAL", "🔴 Critical", "HIGH", "🟠 High", "MEDIUM", "🟡 Medium", "LOW", "🔵 Low", "", "⚪ Unclassified", "⚠️ Unknown Severity")
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Displays the stored severity with a consistent visual marker.
CustomField.label: Severity Indicator
